verdict.rationale: Dropbox's Files API documentation explicitly covers create, read, edit, move, and delete operations over REST endpoints, with official SDKs (JS, Python, etc.) and code samples (e.g. filesListFolder) demonstrating real API usage beyond the desktop client, plus webhooks and OAuth support. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs/SDK repos, and a live OpenAPI/spec probe (probe shows 404s for openapi.json/docs-md), so full documentation completeness can't be independently verified from evidence alone.
